title: Chapter 135: Chasing Down The Remaining Enemies
content:
Chapter 135: Chasing Down The Remaining Enemies

Wu Qing consumed resources and quickly hatched 3,000 hydralisks, increasing the total number of Zerg hydralisks to 18,000, of which nearly 300 were promoted to one star level on their own.

The eight thousand hydralisks on the battlefield of the connecting channel, after a period of recovery by burrowing into the ground, have the strength to fight again.

They gathered together with three thousand newly hatched hydralisks, rushed to the cave space, and joined the puppies gathered in the cave space. A total of 11,000 hydralisks and a large number of puppies headed towards the huge retreat of the underground rat-men. Killed in the channel.

The passages that the Zerg explored yesterday have changed a lot today. Last night, a large number of giant passages were excavated, some of which should be leading to the battlefield of the Zerg base connection passage.

Now these passages are full of rats. If these little things don't take the initiative to attack the Zerg, it will be more troublesome for the Zerg to clean them up.

The Zerg army marched straight forward along the largest passage leading to the underground world. The Zerg did not care about the ordinary rats as long as they did not block the army.

The journey was smooth, and it wasn't until we approached the exit of the passage that we discovered the retreating underground rat-men.

The original huge platform at the exit of the passage has expanded several times in the direction of the passage. Hundreds of thousands of underground rat people are crowded on the platform, with no way to advance or retreat.

I don’t know if the mysterious enemy during the day has weakened its ability to control intelligent creatures like the underground rat people. Now these underground rat people want to withdraw to the underground world.

However, the barrier of the underground world restricts the entry and exit of creatures that originally belong to the underground world. Under normal circumstances, they cannot leave or enter.

These underground rat people were blocked from the barrier of the underground world and had no way out.

Facing the incoming Zerg army, the underground rat-men could only fight to the death.

"Squeak, squeak, squeak...!"

The summoner among the underground ratmen began to summon rats scattered in various passages.

The rats that would have relied on instinct to avoid the Zerg army were all called upon to attack the Zerg army.

The attack power of these rats was too weak compared to the Zerg. Hydralisks sprayed some biological decomposition fluid in several directions where the rats were attacking. The rats automatically pounced on the biological decomposition fluid like moths to a flame. The light disappears.

To kill these little mice, the consumption of biological decomposition liquid is minimal. Some biological decomposition liquid is sprayed in the channel, which can continuously kill the mice rushing over.

The rats that were lucky enough to rush in front of the Zerg army were killed by the Zerg puppies with a casual wave of their blade arms. These rats were not enough to kill at all.

This kind of rat is a consumable used by the underground rats to consume the Zerg. They don't expect to bring much harm to the Zerg. They are satisfied if they can consume some hydralisks' biological decomposition fluid and the puppy's physical strength.

Led by nearly three hundred one-star Hydralisks, the Zerg army successfully rushed out of the passage and arrived on the huge platform amid the interference of the rats.

"Perhaps there was no platform here originally, but it was excavated temporarily by those weird things?"

Wu Qing thought so as he saw this platform that had expanded several times from the perspective of the Zerg.

With that weird digging ability, it is really easy to build such a platform.

Seeing a large number of underground rats on the platform, Wu Qing sent all the puppies from the Zerg territory. The Zerg territory was still very safe during the day, and he could rest easy by relying on defensive buildings.

The Zerg territory is still rioting to replenish the troops lost last night. The construction work of the Zerg territory will be carried out immediately after Wu Qing and the insect queen discuss it.

As the Zerg army rushed out of the passage, the Hydralisks began to spray attacks on the area where the underground rat-men were densely packed, spraying a large amount of Zerg biological decomposition fluid towards the underground rat-people.

The throwers among the underground ratmen also threw a large number of incendiary bombs at the Zerg army.

The one-star Hydralisks all took action to intercept the incendiary bombs in the air, and exploded most of the incendiary bombs in the air. When the incendiary bombs landed on the Zerg army, there were also Zerg puppies who used their shields to rush towards them and put out the fire with their bodies.

As long as they are not burned to death at once, they will retreat, burrow into the ground and recover for a while, and they will be a lively puppy again.

All 11,000 Hydralisks of the Zerg race rushed out of the passage and formed an array to launch a full-scale attack on the Underground Ratmen!

The Zerg biological decomposition liquid is extremely effective against small races like the Subterranean Ratmen, and large areas of the Subterranean Ratmen disappear in the form of light.

Wu Qing clearly felt that the morale of these underground rat people was constantly declining, and they could no longer organize an effective counterattack!

"Without the control of the mysterious enemy, these underground rat-men finally returned to their normal state of intelligent creatures?"

Wu Qing felt that the current appearance of these underground rat-men was what normal intelligent creatures should look like.

Those ghouls are somewhat similar to the Zerg. They are not like normal intelligent creatures. They fought to the death like that yesterday.

But today, these underground rats are flesh and blood, regardless of their intelligence. Even if they only rely on biological instincts, when they are cornered and faced with such a fierce attack from the Zerg, their morale will collapse.

The Zerg didn't pay any attention to these armies that still needed morale to support them.

Under the protection of the Zerg puppies, 11,000 Hydralisks quickly cleaned up the underground ratmen on the platform like they were cleaning up garbage.

…

With no worries about the war, Wu Qing discussed with the Insect Queen and began the expansion of the Zerg underground territory.

The larger the Zerg territory, the greater the potential for development of the Zerg. This is a very simple truth, provided that it can be defended.

If the Zerg territory is not expanded, the Zerg will not be able to deploy its troops when it encounters a stronger attack than last night.

If they want to quickly build troops, it is difficult to find space for a new mother nest.

The larger the Zerg territory, the greater the strategic depth of the Zerg, and they can deploy more defensive buildings and defensive forces. If necessary, they can also give up some unimportant territories to protect the Zerg core territory.

In short, if they can defend it, the larger the Zerg territory, the better.

The huge space that Weird dug on both sides of the Zerg base connecting channel last night is the direction of the Zerg territory expansion today. With the ready-made underground space, the Zerg worker bees do not need to spend time and effort to dig.

But the Zerg worker bees cannot be idle. They must expand the underground base of the Zerg territory as soon as possible to the connecting channel of the two spaces, and perfectly integrate the two new underground spaces with the Zerg underground base, making them indistinguishable from each other.

The connecting channel is the weak point of the Zerg territory, and it must be eliminated as soon as possible.

With this expansion, the area of the Zerg underground base has increased exponentially.
